title: Nested slice extension stalk maps
statement: Let $X$ be a topological space, $F$ an abelian sheaf on its open-set site [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology], and $V\subseteq U$ open subsets. Write $P_W$ for the slice extension presheaf [def-weil-pbc-site-extension-by-zero-presheaf] of the restriction of $F$ to the slice over $W$. Thus $P_W(A)=\bigoplus_{A\to W}F(A)$, with restrictions given by precomposition of indices and restriction in $F$. There exists a presheaf morphism $g:P_V\to P_U$ whose stalk map [def-weil-pbc-module-stalk] is an isomorphism at every $x\in V$.

source.place: Lemma 0A38 final paragraph; Lemma 00A5(3), (4) (lemma-j-shriek-abelian); presheaf direct-sum construction as in Modules on Sites, 03DI and 03EJ

proof.text: Construct g explicitly: its component on an open W sends each direct-sum injection indexed by phi : W → V to the injection indexed by phi followed by V → U, with the identity on F(W). Check naturality on each injection using the definition of restriction and associativity (or uniqueness of arrows in the poset of opens).

For W contained in V, construct the inverse component by sending each summand indexed by W → U into the summand indexed by the inclusion W → V. Both composites are the identity, checked on each injection; the index types are subsingletons. Thus g(W) is bijective.

For x in V, Mathlib TopCat.Presheaf.exists_le_germ_eq represents any stalk element on an open contained in V. Component surjectivity then proves stalk surjectivity. For injectivity, represent both elements on such opens and use TopCat.Presheaf.germ_eq to find a common neighborhood witnessing equality of image sections. This neighborhood remains contained in V; naturality and component injectivity imply equality of the restricted source sections, and TopCat.Presheaf.germ_ext gives equality of the germs. ConcreteCategory.isIso_iff_bijective concludes.
